title: Cleaner commands, a browsable /help, and /verify works again
changes: Fixed: /verify was broken. Members who ran it got the form, filled it in, and were told the interaction failed. The panel button was never affected, so if your members verify through the panel nothing changed for you. /verify now opens the same form the panel button does
Every command has been cleaned up. No emoji anywhere, no stray dashes, and the wording is plainer throughout
/help is now a menu instead of one very long message. Pick a category and read just that, rather than scrolling past every feature and all 78 commands to find one thing
Screens you work in, like the databases, the setup pages and /help, now carry Open CAD and Website buttons underneath. Short confirmations and errors stay plain
The Fire Department database now looks like the civilian and LEO ones instead of a line of bold text
The /setup list stopped saying everything twice. It now only spells out what is still missing
